note: The partition keeps both columns on the family's own id (1.5), and a column owner moves B's 2020 row to the split 1.5.b. An enrichment naming the family-retaining owner `a` would select every literal record of family 5, B's included, so it is refused as over-broad. The allowed twin, an entry on a split owner, is enrichment-of-a-partition-owner-reaches-only-its-column.
fails_if: `compile_enrichment` (curation_compile.py) drops the check that a native-family target has no split siblings, so the description for `a` is applied to the whole family and also lands on B's variable `b`

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers A (CVID 21) and B (CVID 22) in 2020.
